artefact: local D1 reproduction of the inactivity-decay demotion sweep

environment.persist_to: .wrangler-closeout (local only; no remote binding used, no credentials)
environment.trigger: GET /cdn-cgi/local/scheduled — wrangler's local cron trigger, invoking the worker's scheduled handler
environment.note: The `whitelist` table is provisioned outside this repository (no CREATE TABLE for it exists in the tree; `ensure_schema` only ALTERs it), so a local fixture table was created with the exact columns the sweep reads. `governance_receipts` and `admin_log` were created by the worker's own `ensure_schema` on first request.

fixture.tied_timestamps: the first 200 idle rows share one identical last_active_at, exercising the keyset tiebreak against real SQLite ordering

TL3, idle — must never be auto-demoted
TL2, idle, days=12 reads=50 posts=10 — breaks the TL2 hysteresis band but still earns TL1
TL2, idle, no activity — must land directly on TL0
TL1, idle, days=100 reads=100 posts=100 — clears the TL1 band, must be held
TL2, active 1000s ago — inside the window, must not be a candidate

runs.name: full sweep
runs.worker_log: trust demotion sweep: scanned=403 demoted=402 truncated=false
runs.expected_candidates: 403 = 400 idle TL1 + dd + cc + bb (ff/ee/aa correctly excluded by the candidate predicate)
assertions_passed: all 400 idle TL1 rows reached TL0 — the OFFSET implementation processed 200 of these and reported clean completion
aa.. remained TL2 (active, never a candidate)
cc.. reached TL0 (TL2 -> TL0 direct, as ADR-2006 permits)
dd.. reached TL1 (TL2 -> TL1, still earns it)

runs.name: convergence / no double counting
runs.worker_log: (silent — the log is gated on demoted>0 || failed>0 || truncated || aborted, and this sweep demoted nothing)
assertions_passed: re-running the sweep over the same data committed nothing further
audit count unchanged at 402 — no double counting on re-run

runs.name: audit-write failure injection
runs.setup: 100 rows reset to TL1; `admin_log` renamed away so the audit INSERT — the second statement of the commit batch — fails
worker_log: WARNING sweep_inactive_demotions: 100 demotion(s) did not commit
trust demotion sweep: scanned=102 demoted=0 held=2 failed=100 truncated=false aborted=false
assertions_passed: NOT ONE trust level changed — the D1 batch is genuinely all-or-nothing, so a failed audit INSERT rolls back its paired UPDATE
demoted=0: counts represent committed changes only. The previous implementation discarded both write results and returned the planned level, so these 100 would have been reported as demotions
failed=100 is reported explicitly, and the scanned == demoted + held + failed invariant holds (102 == 0 + 2 + 100)
held=2 (bb.. and dd..) is distinguished from failed, not collapsed into a single 'not demoted' bucket

runs.name: restart reconciliation
runs.worker_log: trust demotion sweep: scanned=102 demoted=100 held=2 failed=0 truncated=false aborted=false
assertions_passed: the next sweep committed exactly the 100 that had failed, and nothing else
audit count 402 + 100 = 502 — one entry per committed change, no duplicates from the failed attempt
the sweep recovers without operator intervention or a persisted cursor

receipts_api_probe.schema_live: governance_receipts created on D1 by ensure_schema with stage/stage_error/decision_id/signed_at/accepted_at/projected_at/replays present

not_covered: A signed 31402/31403 governance journey over the relay WebSocket was not driven: minting a NIP-98 or a signed governance event needs schnorr signing, and no Node signing library is installed in this container. The receipt stage machine is covered by 14 unit tests with failure injection; its D1 batch is verified live only indirectly, via the identical batch mechanism proven all-or-nothing in run 3.
No remote D1 and no relay credentials were used at any point.
